title: THE OBSTACLE COURSE · BODYWEIGHT LAPS
why: Same gauntlet style, brand-new stations: the bells sit out except one, and the work is pushing, jumping, crawling and holding your own 250 lb. Four laps for time, a hill sprint off every lap.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 7 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day C flow · one continuous ground sequence

items.name: Rock-backs ×10
items.detail: all fours, hips to heels, spine long

items.name: Segmental rolls ×3/side
items.detail: lead with the arm, then the leg

items.name: Cross-crawls ×10/side
items.detail: standing, elbow to opposite knee, slow

items.name: Baby crawl 10 yd out and back
items.detail: knees down, opposite hand and knee

items.name: Scapular push-ups ×10
items.detail: arms locked, only the shoulder blades move

items.name: Pogo hops 30s
items.detail: stiff ankles, quick off the floor

blocks.title: THE OBSTACLE COURSE · 4 LAPS FOR TIME
blocks.meta: FOR TIME · 4 LAPS · 8 stations + 1 hill sprint per lap · cap 26:00 · bodyweight + 35 lb
blocks.format: One clock. A lap is the eight stations in order, then the belt. Move straight through; rest only where you have to. Record the total time for 4 laps, the station that cost the most, and RPE.
blocks.workRest: HILL SPRINT every lap: 0.10 mi at 8.0 mph on 8% grade (about 45 seconds), then straight back to station 1. Lap 4: 8.5 mph if laps 1 to 3 were under 6:00 each.

items.name: S1 · Pike push-up, feet on the bench ×10
items.detail: hips high, head to the floor between the hands

items.name: S2 · Depth drop to broad jump ×5
items.detail: step off the bench, land soft, jump forward at once

items.name: S3 · Towel hamstring curl ×10
items.detail: on your back, heels on towels, bridge up and drag the heels in

items.name: S4 · Pistol squat to the bench ×6/side
items.detail: one leg, sit back to the bench, stand without the other foot touching

items.name: S5 · Crab walk 10 yd out, bear crawl 10 yd back
items.detail: hips up on the crab, knees an inch off the floor on the bear

items.name: S6 · Split jumps ×8/side
items.detail: lunge, jump, switch legs in the air

items.name: S7 · Kettlebell figure-8 35 lb ×10
items.detail: pass the bell between the legs in a figure eight, standing tall

items.name: S8 · Wall sit with the 35 lb on the thighs 45s
items.detail: thighs level, back flat on the wall

items.name: HILL · RUN 0.10 mi @ 8.0 / 8% · every lap
items.detail: sprint, then recover walking to S1

blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 3 laps, pike push-ups from the floor, pistols ×4/side, hill at 7.0 / 6%.
blocks.text: Pike push-up: feet on the bench, body folded at the hips, lower the crown of the head toward the floor and press back up. Depth drop: step off the bench, absorb the landing, then broad jump immediately. Pistol to bench: lower on one leg until you touch the bench, then drive up; hold the free leg out front. Figure-8: hand the bell around the outside of one leg, through the middle, around the other.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · flutter kicks + superman + bicycle · straight through

items.name: Flutter kicks ×40
items.detail: low back pressed down, heels 6 inches off the floor

items.name: Superman, 2-count hold ×10
items.detail: arms and legs off the floor together

items.name: Bicycle crunch ×20/side
items.detail: slow, elbow to the opposite knee
